67371-bokwala-the-story-of-a-congo-victi.title: The Story Of A Congo Victim
67371-bokwala-the-story-of-a-congo-victi.creator: A Congo Resident
67371-bokwala-the-story-of-a-congo-victi.description: A book by A Congo Resident. women were enslaved—Feeding the idle—Endeavours to evade  oppression—Results—How would you like our conditions?—Forest  work—Its hardships—The day of reckoning—Back to the village and  home—An ominous silence—A sad discovery—Redeeming our wives—An  offending villager—A poor victim—A ghastly punishment—The woman’s  death—Another village—The monkey hunters—The old man who stayed at  home—How he was tortured—No redress.

arxiv-2105-03458.title: Duplex Sequence-to-Sequence Learning for Reversible Machine Translation
arxiv-2105-03458.creator: Zaixiang Zheng, Hao Zhou, Shujian Huang, Jiajun Chen, Jingjing Xu, Lei Li
arxiv-2105-03458.description: Abstract Sequence-to-sequence learning naturally has two directions. How to effectively utilize supervision signals from both directions? Existing approaches either require two separate models, or a multitask-learned model but with inferior performance. In this paper, we propose REDER ( Re versible D uplex Transform er ), a parameter-efficient model and apply it to machine translation.

arxiv-2109-00590.title: WebQA: Multihop and Multimodal QA
arxiv-2109-00590.creator: Yingshan Chang 1 Mridu Narang 2 Hisami Suzuki 2 Guihong Cao 2 Jianfeng Gao 3 Yonatan Bisk 1,3 1 Carnegie Mellon University 2 Microsoft, Bing Search 3 Microsoft Research
arxiv-2109-00590.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Yingshan Chang 1 Mridu Narang 2 Hisami Suzuki 2 Guihong Cao 2 Jianfeng Gao 3 Yonatan Bisk 1,3 1 Carnegie Mellon University 2 Microsoft, Bing Search 3 Microsoft Research. Scaling Visual Question Answering (VQA) to the open-domain and multi-hop nature of web searches, requires fundamental advances in visual representation learning, knowledge aggregation, and language generation.

arxiv-2211-03991.title: Dynamic Interpretable Change Point Detection
arxiv-2211-03991.creator: Kopal Garg, Jennifer Yu, Tina Behrouzi, Sana Tonekaboni, Anna Goldenberg
arxiv-2211-03991.description: Abstract Identifying change points (CPs) in a time series is crucial to guide better decision making across various fields like finance and healthcare and facilitating timely responses to potential risks or opportunities. Existing Change Point Detection (CPD) methods have a limitation in tracking changes in the joint distribution of multidimensional features.

arxiv-2308-02638.title: Nature of even and odd magic angles in helical twisted trilayer graphene
arxiv-2308-02638.creator: Daniele Guerci, Yuncheng Mao, Christophe Mora
arxiv-2308-02638.description: Abstract Helical twisted trilayer graphene exhibits zero-energy flat bands with large degeneracy in the chiral limit. The flat bands emerge at a discrete set of magic twist angles and feature properties intrinsically distinct from those realized in twisted bilayer graphene. Their degeneracy and the associated band Chern numbers depend on the parity of the magic angles.

arxiv-2312-02042.title: Kirchhoff Meets Johnson: In Pursuit of Unconditionally Secure Communication
arxiv-2312-02042.creator: Ertugrul Basar
arxiv-2312-02042.description: Abstract Noise: an enemy to be dealt with and a major factor limiting communication system performance. However, what if there is gold in that garbage? In conventional engineering, our focus is primarily on eliminating, suppressing, combating, or even ignoring noise and its detrimental impacts. Conversely, could we exploit it similarly to biology, which utilizes noise-alike carrier signals to convey information?

arxiv-2404-12027.title: Systematic search for islets of stability in the standard map for large parameter values
arxiv-2404-12027.creator: Alexandre R. Nieto, Rubén Capeáns, Miguel A.F. Sanjuán
arxiv-2404-12027.description: Abstract In the seminal paper (Phys. Rep. 52 , 263, 1979), Boris Chirikov showed that the standard map does not exhibit a boundary to chaos, but rather that there are small islands (“islets”) of stability for arbitrarily large values of the nonlinear perturbation.

arxiv-2505-11725.title: CLT and Edgeworth Expansion for m-out-of-n Bootstrap Estimators of The Studentized Median
arxiv-2505-11725.creator: Imon Banerjee, Sayak Chakrabarty
arxiv-2505-11725.description: Abstract The m-out-of-n bootstrap—proposed by Bickel et al. 1992 —approximates the distribution of a statistic by repeatedly drawing m m subsamples ( m ≪ n m\ll n ) without replacement from an original sample of size n; it is now routinely used for robust inference with heavy-tailed data, bandwidth selection, and other large-sample applications.

pmc-10529512.title: Preparation and Degradation Performance Study of P(AM/GG/PEGDA) Nanocomposite Self-Degradation Gel Plugging Material
pmc-10529512.creator: Dan Bao, Siyuan Liu, Xianli Zhang, Feng Li, Jiaqin Wang, Huan Jia, Shanghao Liu, Peng Zhang
pmc-10529512.description: Lost circulation is a world-class problem, and the contradiction between plugging and unplugging in reservoirs is a problem that needs to be solved urgently. The traditional LCM is not suitable for reservoirs and the complex subsequent operations. Currently, a self-degrading plugging material is proposed.

pmc-11350999.title: The association between non‑high‑density lipoprotein cholesterol to high‑density lipoprotein cholesterol ratio (NHHR) and low muscle mass in adults aged 20–59: a population-based study in the United States
pmc-11350999.creator: Jia-qi Hao, Zi-xuan Zhuang, Shu-yue Hu, Yu-jie Zhang, Jia-wan Zhang, Feng-Jun He, Rui Wang, Wen Zhuang, Mo-jin Wang
pmc-11350999.description: BackgroundThe ratio between non-high-density lipoprotein cholesterol and high-density lipoprotein cholesterol (NHHR) is a reliable marker for assessing the risk linked to lipid metabolism disorders. Sarcopenia, characterized by age-related loss of muscle mass and strength/function, includes the assessment of muscle mass, muscle strength, and muscle-specific strength. However, research into NHHR’s relationship with low muscle mass risk remains unexplored.

pmc-11590557.title: Cost-effectiveness analysis of anticoagulation options for non-valvular atrial fibrillation in Iran
pmc-11590557.creator: Satar Rezaei, Maryam Bavandpour, Mohammadreza Mobinizadeh, Rajabali Daroudi
pmc-11590557.description: BackgroundAtrial fibrillation (AF) imposes a substantial economic and clinical burden, particularly in developing countries like Iran. This study aimed to evaluate the cost-effectiveness of anticoagulation options for non-valvular atrial fibrillation (NVAF) in Iran.MethodsWe conducted a cost-effectiveness analysis comparing warfarin, apixaban, dabigatran 110 mg, dabigatran 150 mg, and rivaroxaban for NVAF patients from the Iranian payer’s perspective.

pmc-11644315.title: Resilient Multi-Robot Coverage Path Redistribution Using Boustrophedon Decomposition for Environmental Monitoring
pmc-11644315.creator: Junghwan Gong, Hyunbin Kim, Seunghwan Lee, Javier Prieto
pmc-11644315.description: This study introduces a resilient and adaptive multi-robot coverage path planning approach based on the Boustrophedon Cell Decomposition algorithm, designed to dynamically redistribute coverage tasks in the event of robot failures. The proposed method ensures minimal disruption and maintains a balanced workload across operational robots through a propagation-based redistribution strategy.

pmc-11716892.title: In vivo 18F‐MK6240 tau PET imaging in relation to peripheral inflammation and episodic memory in late middle‐aged adults
pmc-11716892.creator: Mona‐Lisa Malarte, Konstantinos Chiotis, Konstantinos Ioannou, Elena Rodriguez‐Vieitez
pmc-11716892.description: BackgroundDetecting early stages of Alzheimer's disease (AD) remains a crucial yet complex challenge. While recent interest has surged in detecting biomarkers linked with the disease preclinical phase, a comprehensive understanding of the concomitant peripheral biological pathways before the potential disease onset is necessary.

pmc-12628790.title: When state Medicaid demonstrations end: projected eligibility loss after a MassHealth housing support program transition
pmc-12628790.creator: Nicole C McCann, Heather E Hsu, Stephanie Ettinger de Cuba, Jasper Frank, Paulina Lange, Michael D Stein, Paul R Shafer
pmc-12628790.description: IntroductionMassachusetts Medicaid (MassHealth) transitioned a Section 1115 waiver-based housing support program to a permanent program in 2025, implementing new eligibility restrictions.MethodsWe projected the potential impact of these new eligibility restrictions using linked administrative claims and programmatic data.ResultsAmong individuals enrolled from 2021 to 2024, 68% would no longer qualify under updated 2025 criteria.

pmc-12743066.title: Self-Reflective Chest X-Ray Report Generation with Clinical-Aware Detection and Multilevel Readability
pmc-12743066.creator: Juhyuk Han, Minjae Kim, Yeonwoo Kim, Won Hee Lee
pmc-12743066.description: Clinical documentation demands necessitate automated solutions balancing clinical precision with patient comprehension. This study aims to develop and validate a unified framework that maintains diagnostic accuracy while dynamically adapting medical report complexity to diverse literacy levels, and to establish comprehensive evaluation methodologies for patient-centered medical documentation.

pmc-13193781.title: Functional effects of rosmarinic acid on gut health and epigenetic regulation in antibiotic-free poultry diets
pmc-13193781.creator: Mohamed E Abd El-Hack, Elwy A Ashour, Asmaa F Khafaga, Hadeel K Khaleel, Mahmoud Kamal, Ayman E Taha, Ahmed E Alfifi, Mohammed Al-Rasheed, Mohammad MH Khan
pmc-13193781.description: Rosmarinic acid (RA), a bioactive polyphenol found in Salvia officinalis and other Lamiaceae herbs, has attracted attention for its functional feed application in animal nutrition. RA supplementation positively influences growth efficiency, liver antioxidant status, and serum biochemical indices in broilers. Its antimicrobial and immunomodulatory effects promote health and productivity.

pmc-13245466.title: Clinical Characteristics and Treatment Outcomes in Ovarian Carcinosarcoma: A Retrospective Cohort Study of 90 Cases
pmc-13245466.creator: Shihan Wan, Li Yang, Beier Wu, Jingfang Liu, Yiping Jin, Jie Xing, Jiejie Zhang, Aijun Yu
pmc-13245466.description: ObjectiveOvarian carcinosarcoma is a rare and highly aggressive subtype of ovarian cancer. This cohort study aimed to examine clinicopathological features, treatment patterns, and survival outcomes to enhance clinical practice and guide future research.DesignWe conducted a retrospective study of 90 patients diagnosed with ovarian carcinosarcoma between 2006 and 2020.Patients and MethodsDemographic, clinical, histopathological, and treatment-related data were systematically collected and summarized.

pmc-13289471.title: When the meningitis–encephalitis panel is negative: off-label joint infection PCR detects CTX-M ESBL–producing Proteus mirabilis in adult meningoencephalitis
pmc-13289471.creator: Márk Kozák, Levente Majoros, Ferenc Bodnár, Rebeka Hodossy-Takács, Lilla Hudák, Lilla Rácz, Viktor Bencs, István Várkonyi
pmc-13289471.description: Spontaneous Gram-negative bacillary meningitis in adults is rare and carries high mortality, particularly in elderly patients with significant comorbidities. Although multiplex meningitis-encephalitis (ME) panels have improved diagnostic turnaround time, their limited pathogen spectrum may reduce sensitivity for certain clinically relevant Gram-negative organisms.

pmc-13293814.title: Biological functions and clinical efficacy of IL-5/IL-5Rα-targeted therapies across eosinophilia-associated diseases
pmc-13293814.creator: Johannes Lübke, Andreas Reiter, Juliana Schwaab
pmc-13293814.description: Interleukin-5 (IL-5) is a central regulator of eosinophil differentiation, maturation, survival, activation, and mobilization, and it contributes to eosinophil recruitment to inflamed tissues. These biological functions have made the IL-5/IL-5 receptor alpha (IL-5Rα) pathway a key therapeutic target in eosinophil-associated diseases.
